source: guess_cases_lore.txt and guess_cases_session.txt in this folder: invented text for DMbot's tests, written for #4655 (quests slice 7; design docs/design/quests.md §7). Every name and line is made up; the four player characters are the sample's, by name only, so sample_run can say who plays each.

how_to_read.readings: the table's guesses read from the session (#4655): who holds it ('party' when the whole table agreed out loud, else the player character's name), the statement as subject, relationship and object (names as in the key; the relationship's word is not scored), and the mystery it answers. Found: a guess (a theory or an accusation) in that point of view, kept as a belief or waiting as a reading. Wrong holder: the same statement in another point of view. Missed: neither. The direction of the statement is not scored (either way round matches), and a guess held by the party where the key has a character (or the other way round) counts as wrong holder.
how_to_read.must_not_readings: lines that must make no guess in any point of view: a joke, a question, the DM's own hint and a plan. One kept or waiting is counted as false.
how_to_read.line: the line of the session file (or the lore, for nodes and threads) that holds it; blank lines count
